name: Mortgage
overview: Scripture addresses the reality of mortgages as a form of borrowing, highlighting the spiritual and practical implications of debt. Nehemiah 5:3 reveals how mortgaging land and homes can result from urgent needs, while Proverbs 22:7 warns that borrowers become servants to lenders, emphasizing the bondage of debt. Believers are encouraged in Romans 13:8 to owe nothing to anyone except love, underscoring the call to financial responsibility. Additionally, Matthew 6:25 reminds Christians to trust God for provision rather than be consumed by anxiety over material needs, and Proverbs 21:20 praises wise stewardship and saving, contrasting it with foolish spending.
